# ReeferDude — full context

Website: https://reeferdude.com/
Co-founders: Ray Meadows and Jessica Mullins.
What this site is: the AI budtender flagship — a cannabis-infused chat where a floating avatar's smoke forms the menu — strain matching, a 3D print-on-demand Design Studio, grow-room blueprinting, a ghost marketplace, delivery and consultations. The store engine lives at potgrowhub.store.

Membership tiers displayed on the site: Seed Starter $19/mo, Master Grower $49/mo, Ganjapreneur $99/mo. Checkout is not live; no page takes payment.
Hemp-derived products only. No actual cannabis is sold. 18+ only. This content is general education, not medical advice.
